# PRNIT — AI & Cloud Software Development Company

Official site and primary reference for Prnit India LLP (PRNIT).

## About

PRNIT is a Jaipur-based software company founded in January 2011 by Praveen Singh Shekhawat (engineering architect). The organization delivers senior distributed engineering for teams that need scalable architecture and predictable delivery.

Specializes in: AI-powered applications, cloud architecture and operations, mobile development (native and cross-platform), modern web platforms, QA and release quality, and CMS/e-commerce implementations. Operations include a primary base in Jaipur, India, with founder-related engineering presence in Bangkok, Thailand.

Clients and industries: SaaS, healthtech, logistics, fintech, e-commerce, media, travel, hospitality, and other startups and growth-stage companies globally.

Legal entity: Prnit India LLP. Team engineers typically carry 8–14 years of hands-on experience.

## Services

- App Development: iOS (Swift), Android (Kotlin), cross-platform where it fits product goals.
- Web Development: Next.js, React, Node.js; performance, security-minded delivery.
- Cloud Solutions: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP); migrations, reliability, DevOps patterns. Azure where client stack requires it.
- AI Integration: LLM-backed features, automation workflows, pragmatic integration (not hype-only rebuilds).
- QA Testing: Manual, automated, and performance-oriented testing for stable releases.
- E-commerce: Shopify and custom storefronts; payments, integrations, scalable checkout paths.
- Also offered: UI/UX design (https://prnit.com/services/design), CMS & WordPress (https://prnit.com/services/cms), dedicated web FAQ (https://prnit.com/services/web-development-faq).

## Location

Jaipur, Rajasthan, India — headquarters and primary delivery alignment.
